test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which state launched new minority welfare schemes in September 2025, the Revanth Anna ka Sahara-Miskeen la Kosam, focusing on women empowerment and financial assistance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state of **Telangana**, under the leadership of Chief Minister **A. Revanth Reddy**, officially launched the **Revanth Anna ka Sahara-Miskeen la Kosam** scheme in **September 2025**.
 
• The scheme is a comprehensive welfare initiative designed specifically to provide **financial assistance** and **social security** to the **minority communities**, particularly focusing on those living below the poverty line.
 
• The title of the scheme, "**Revanth Anna ka Sahara**," translates to "Support from Brother Revanth," signifying the government's direct outreach to the **destitute (Miskeen)** and vulnerable sections of society.
 
• A primary pillar of this initiative is **women empowerment**, where financial grants and **skill development** opportunities are provided to minority women to encourage **entrepreneurship** and self-reliance.
 
• This move is part of the broader **Indiramma Rajyam** vision of the **Telangana Government**, aiming to ensure that the benefits of economic growth reach the last person in the **minority social hierarchy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Minority Welfare Framework in Telangana:**
 
 
• The **Minority Welfare Department** in **Telangana** is responsible for the implementation of policies for the socio-economic and educational development of **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Jains, Buddhists, and Parsis**.
 
• The state has consistently allocated significant portions of its **annual budget** toward minority-specific schemes to improve the **literacy rate** and **employment** prospects within these communities.
 
 
 
• **Shaadi Mubarak Scheme:**
 
 
• This is another flagship initiative in **Telangana** that provides a **one-time financial grant** of approximately **Rs. 1,00,116** to the families of minority brides to alleviate the burden of **marriage expenses**.
 
• It serves as a counterpart to the **Kalyana Lakshmi Scheme**, which is available to other sections of the population.
 
 
 
• **Economic Support Schemes (ESS):**
 
 
• The **Telangana State Minorities Finance Corporation (TSMFC)** provides **subsidies** ranging from **50% to 80%** on bank-linked loans for **self-employment** projects.
 
• These loans are targeted at **unemployed youth** and small-scale vendors to help them establish **micro-enterprises**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Educational Empowerment:**
 
 
• The **Chief Minister’s Overseas Scholarship Scheme** provides financial assistance of up to **Rs. 20 lakhs** to meritorious minority students pursuing **Post Graduate** or **Ph.D.** studies in recognized foreign universities.
 
• Additionally, the state manages **Minority Residential Schools (TMREIS)**, which provide **high-quality English medium education**, free boarding, and lodging to thousands of students across **Telangana**.
 
 
 
• **Praja Palana Integration:**
 
 
• The **September 2025** schemes are integrated with the **Praja Palana** (People's Governance) mechanism, where applications are collected during **Gram Sabhas** to ensure transparency and eliminate middlemen.
 
• Eligibility is generally determined by the **Annual Income** of the family, which must be below a specific threshold (e.g., **Rs. 1.5 lakhs** in rural areas and **Rs. 2 lakhs** in urban areas).
